up: Retrieve distinct ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for all compounds that have activity data against the target CHEMBL261 (human carbonic anhydrase I). Sort the results by ChEMBL ID in ascending order. Return all matching rows without applying any row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL261' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
